screen.rationale: Primary study; LDPE particles in an NH2-MIL-88B(Fe) photocatalytic membrane reactor under a 400 W metal lamp (180 W/m2, passes E3), but outcomes are only mass loss (22.3% membrane, 37.9% powder), rejection ratios, particle size, FTIR, CO2 by GC and TOC (SI figures); the text states no specific liquid products were identified, and no molar mass is reported.
